newsitem.title: JAPAN: M'bishi Motors sees larger sales, export in 97/98.
newsitem.headline: M'bishi Motors sees larger sales, export in 97/98.

text.p: Mitsubishi Motors Corp said on Thursday it expected its combined domestic vehicle sales and exports in the year from April 1, 1997, to be 1.34 million units, up from its actual combined domestic sales and exports of 1.25 million units in the previous year.
The company said in a statement it expects 1997/98 domestic sales of 860,000 units, up from actual sales of 772,000 units in 1996/97.
It also said it expected 1997/98 exports of 480,000 units, down from actual exports of 481,000 million units in 1996/97.
The company said that it expected to produce car parts equivalent to 880,000 vehicles overseas, up from the equivalent 781,000 vehicles in 1996/97.
